product.label: Product / Commercial
product.lighting: Use lighting consistent with the opening frame, keeping product surfaces readable.
product.environment: Keep product identity and scene geometry consistent as the viewpoint or subject moves.
product.motion: Preserve product shape, markings and proportions throughout the requested motion.

portrait.label: Cinematic Portrait
portrait.lighting: Use lighting consistent with the opening frame, keeping facial details readable.
portrait.environment: Keep the person recognizable and the setting spatially coherent as the viewpoint changes.
portrait.motion: Maintain facial identity and coherent anatomy throughout the requested expressions and actions.

landscape.label: Landscape / Nature
landscape.lighting: Use lighting consistent with the opening frame and environment.
landscape.environment: Maintain coherent terrain and spatial relationships as the viewpoint moves.
landscape.motion: Let the described environmental motion unfold continuously without unintended scene changes.

action.label: Action / Motion
action.lighting: Use lighting consistent with the opening frame, keeping the action readable.
action.environment: Keep the subject recognizable and the action spatially coherent as it unfolds.
action.motion: Follow the requested speed, direction and scale of action with continuous anatomy and object geometry.
